title: Choosing a mounting location
intro: Where you put the gateway decides how far your sensors can reach it. A few minutes spent choosing the spot saves a lot of troubleshooting later.

content.text: Radio signals travel best in a straight line. Mount the gateway as high as you practically and safely can, so that fewer things stand between it and your sensors.

image.alt: Diagram comparing a low gateway blocked by equipment with a high gateway with clear line of sight

items.text: Metal walls, roofs and machinery block and reflect radio signals.
Thick concrete walls weaken the signal.
Keep the antenna upright, with open space around it.

sections.heading: Stay central, near power and network

content.text: Place the gateway near the middle of the area your sensors cover, within reach of a power outlet and your network.
